question: On the fixed Boolean ideal over F65537, does the ordinary printed basis equal (xy,x^2-x,y^2-y), while -S by x prints (x-1,y), exhibiting the proved ordinary-F4Run domain boundary?

claims.text: Every actual original F4Run remains in its input ideal; y belongs to this saturation but is outside the ideal. Decided only by Lean.
The two fixed native calls print the registered bases, verified by exact polynomial arithmetic and known-answer comparisons.
Full C refinement, row-by-row traces, runtime, distributions, security, other-machine independence and signed execution are outside scope.

arms.description: Saturation by final generator x, reduced grevlex basis

negative.not_applicable_reason: No population hypothesis. Ordinary basis is the ideal-preserving control; exact Lean evaluation at(0,1) separates y from the ideal.
